name: Bismuth Android
description: Experimental GLES 3.1 GPU atlas-culling bridge for Geometry Dash Android 2.2081. Requires device testing; original renderer fallback is retained.

gpu-draw-bridge-enabled.name: Enable experimental GPU atlas bridge
gpu-draw-bridge-enabled.description: Runs the experimental GPU atlas path when supported. Disable if you see visual glitches, crashes, or worse performance.
